maddeler.e:
اخترعوا (form VIII)
# اِخْتَرَعُوا (iḵtaraʕū) /ix.ta.ra.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِخْتَرَعَ (iḵtaraʕa)
# اُخْتُرِعُوا (uḵturiʕū) /ux.tu.ri.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِخْتَرَعَ (iḵtaraʕa)
# اِخْتَرِعُوا (iḵtariʕū) /ix.ta.ri.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِخْتَرَعَ (iḵtaraʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
